integrity: The theorem uses a complete mathematical argument and a reproducible supplementary checker. Numerical checks are not treated as proof of asymptotic claims. Historical priority has nonzero uncertainty; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed two-band quantile-conditional-mean ratio test O_n with bands (0,0.3) and (0.8,0.95) is analyzed.
The exact exponent applies to the specified quantile-coupling mismatch and to an explicit upper bound, not necessarily to the total-variation distance itself.
Other ensemble, location-invariant, or multi-band tests may detect the alternatives.
The result does not claim priority for generic binomial concentration tools or other rank-test impossibility results.
title: Exponentially invisible smooth alternatives for the Lévy quantile-conditional-mean ratio test
